issue.title: Show derived Pomodoro homes on remaining unnamed-session surfaces (x close preview, capture-complete names, successor offers, Mac pickers, plugin pickers)

task_type_fields.proposal:
Show each unnamed Pomodoro's derived home label (the `homes` object from docs/pomodoro-homes.md) on the remaining pre-existing surfaces that still print a placeholder, so an unnamed session reads as `sase` instead of `session` / `unnamed` / `Unnamed Pomodoro` / `Pomodoro #N`. Found by bob-cli-9k.land (integration sweep, 2026-10-18) with an unnamed running session linking two `sase` tasks in a scratch vault:

- bob-cli bare-`x` close preview and output: `would close session 0920-0945 → …`, `next: session (created)` (src/native/capture/output.rs around 1629, 1717, 1758, 2005, 2800).
- `bob capture-complete` pomodoro_name candidates: `unnamed - 0920-0945 current name it` with `name: null` (src/native/capture_complete/model.rs:495, render.rs:406,464).
- Successor offer `entry_name` is `""` for an unnamed session (src/native/task_complete/successors.rs:1155).
- Bob Mac Capture pickers and summaries that print "Unnamed Pomodoro"/"Unnamed": ParentTaskPickerPresentation.swift:274,440,462; ActiveTaskPickerPresentation.swift:127,254,269; TaskLinkPickerPresentation.swift:172,416,431; TaskCompletePickerPresentation.swift:175; BlockIDPickerIndex.swift:813,834; CapturePomodoroBlockPresentation.swift:74; CompletionRowContent.swift:391. As a thin client (decisions:mac-capture-is-a-thin-client) these need bob to add an optional R9 `homes` object to the payloads that feed them first.
- bob-plugins pickers that print `Pomodoro #N` or a bare range for unnamed sessions: block-id-prompt `075-pomodoro-link-targets.js:235-246`; bob-navigation-hotkeys `160-pomodoro-reorder.js:206,216` and `200-filtered-picker-modals.js:662,738` (they would need the bob-ledger-tools homes mirror or a shared helper).

Pattern to follow: `pomodoro_homes::attribute_ledger_entry` (forecast, minutes None) for open entries, additive optional `homes` fields with no schema bumps, and print the derived label only when the chip is non-null, exactly like `bob pomodoro` and `capture-pomodoros --tasks`. Derived homes must stay display-only and never become capture `#name` routing targets (docs/pomodoro-homes.md R7).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The bob-cli-9k plan (plan:202610/pomodoro_homes.md) scoped its live surfaces to capture-pomodoros --tasks, bob plan JSON, bob pomodoro, the ledger chips, the Stats panel, and the Mac idle agenda/Refs Today; these picker, completion, close-preview, and successor surfaces predate the epic and were never in its phases, and each needs new bob payload fields plus Mac and plugin consumers across three repos. The 9k landing's own remaining work only integrates the `=` override surfaces that landed during the epic (bob-cli-9j).

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-9k.land's integration sweep found pre-existing surfaces outside the Pomodoro homes plan that still print a placeholder for unnamed sessions now that derived homes exist; they need new payload fields across bob-cli, Bob Mac Capture, and bob-plugins, so they are filed instead of widening the epic.
